decision.explanation: The question asks who the CEO of Nintendo was in 2021. Two distinct names are provided by separate sources: Shuntaro Furukawa (D1S1, D1S2) and Doug Bowser (D2S2). Both are presented as the CEO of Nintendo in the same year, but they refer to different individuals. The documents do not clarify whether these are conflicting claims or if both were CEOs at different times or in different capacities. Since the sources independently assert these names and there is no explicit contradiction or temporal distinction provided, both are retained as valid candidates.
